title: Withdraw cached personal history after canonical access refusal
classification: inherited premerge gap retained by incoming R165; not introduced by metadata composition; not the historical shared-conversion pending failure
mechanism: All unsuccessful action responses, including Unauthorized, throw; React Query retains previous success data and the rendering branch uses it alongside refresh error. No durable canonical withdrawal is recorded.
boundary: assembled React with actual OrganizationContextProvider, QueryClient, ViewRefreshProvider, actual incoming management/history/buttons; external session/fetch/actions/navigation translated at public boundary. No real auth bypass, cross-tenant server read or server write proved.
stop: First confirmed P1 after one minimal repeat and premerge/positive controls. Only preservation/sealing/cleanup afterward.
